select order_item.ORDER_ITEM_ID, order_item.PROJECT_ID, order_item.SOU_ITEM_ID, order_item.ORDER_ID, order_item.ORDER_STATUS, order_item.VENDOR_ID, order_item.ORDER_TAX_PRICE, order_item.MONTHLY_PRODUCTION, order_item.order_round, project.ORDER_END_TIME, item.ITEM_DESC, item.AFFILIATED_UNIT, vendor.VENDOR_NAME from scc_sou_order_item order_item left join scc_sou_item item on order_item.SOU_ITEM_ID = item.SOU_ITEM_ID left join scc_sou_vendor vendor on vendor.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} left join scc_sou_project project on project.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID where
order_item.PROJECT_ID =#{projectId}

SELECT resu.sou_item_id , resu.WIN_VENDOR_ID, resu.WIN_VENDOR_NAME, -- 中标单位 resu.win_vendor_price, -- 中标价格 resu.WIN_NOTICE_REMARK, -- 备注 ven.linkman_name,-- 联系人 ven.phone, -- 联系电话 souItem.item_desc, -- 物资名称 orderItem.METERING_UNIT, -- 计量单位 orderItem.AFFILIATED_UNIT,-- 单位名称 project.CREATED_FULL_NAME, -- 招标负责人 project.sou_no -- 项目编号 FROM scc_sou_order_result resu LEFT join scc_sou_vendor ven ON resu.WIN_VENDOR_ID = ven.vendor_id AND resu.project_id = ven.project_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_item souItem ON resu.sou_item_id = souItem.sou_item_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_order_item orderItem ON resu.sou_item_id = orderItem.sou_item_id AND resu.project_id = orderItem.project_id AND resu.WIN_VENDOR_ID = orderItem.vendor_id LEFT JOIN scc_sou_project project ON resu.project_id = project.project_id WHERE resu.select_status = 'WIN' AND resu.project_id = #{projectId}
